_about: Fatewell house overlay. Facts from the Lania ledger (canon or draft as marked); invented details marked new. Rooms are referenced by Watabou room id (house:<floor>:<room>), which does not change.

house:0:2._basis: ledger: travellers are lodged in the ground-floor room for coin

house:-1:2._basis: ledger: a hired trapper in the cellar room

house:1:0._basis: ledger: Cryspell, his wife and three children

Library.add: Account books for the fen catch share the shelves with Fearnyard scripture.

Trophy room.add: Turtle shells and stuffed marsh fowl crowd the walls.

things.name: account book
things.description: A heavy book of the household's dealings in smoked eel, turtle and fowl.
things.text: Columns of catches bought from the fen trappers, and carts sent to Wolfront market. The last pages are in a different hand, and one entry reads only: 'Strangers at the Khara ford. Watch the road.'

things.name: Swangel Fatewell
things.here: Swangel Fatewell sits at the library table.
things.description: The widow who heads the household and the smokehouses, hunt-master of Bayfshear.
things.talk: Swangel looks up from her accounts. "You came through the fen, not past the posts. I haven't decided what to do about that."
things.barge: Swangel puts down her pen. "In this house, travellers knock. Even the ones who cross borders at night."

topics.border|crossing|posts|khara|birad|fen: Nobody honest crosses the Kinargzig in the dark. I know who you paid, too. I haven't decided yet whether that matters to me.
topics.tax|taxes|captaincy|poll: The Captaincy takes near a quarter of every head in this house. Turning in strangers pays a bounty. You see my difficulty.
topics.cryspell|son|cart|carts: My son carts the smoked catch to Wolfront. He'll be back before you're rested, and he talks to everyone.
topics.follower|followed|stranger|watching|road: Someone was asking along the Molten road. Thin, quiet, paid in good coin. Not one of ours.
topics.smokehouse|smokehouses|eel|eels|catch|tu: Eel, turtle, fowl. The fen gives, we smoke, Wolfront eats. It has kept this house standing for three generations.
topics.room|bed|stay|lodging: The ground-floor room is let to travellers. For coin, and for quiet.

coins|copper|money.text: Swangel weighs the coins in her palm. "That's the room paid. Quiet is extra; consider this the start of it."

invite.text: Swangel almost laughs. "I have a household and a smokehouse. You have a border behind you. No."

things.name: hired trapper
things.here: A hired trapper is mending snares on a cot.
things.description: A wiry trapper the household hires for the fen lines.
things.greet: The trapper nods without looking up from his snares.

topics.fen|marsh|snares|traps|eels: The fen will drown a horse and feed a village. Stay on the dry necks and it'll do neither to you.
topics.swangel|mistress|widow: She pays fair and she remembers everything. Don't owe her.
